approach: Approach 17: equal-weight late fusion of Approach 5 and Approach 8
decision_rule: score_bad = mean(approach5 SVM decision, DINOv2 SVM decision); >= 0 means bad
approach5_features: automatic material mask; LAB histograms 12/16/16 bins; 8 gradient/Laplacian/intensity texture statistics (52-d)
dino_features: masked bounding-box crop, background filled with median material colour; patch-token mean, std, P90 (1152-d); PCA 32 whitened
warning: Fitted on ten physical bricks photographed on paper. The uncertainty margin was read from the held-out sweep on the same bricks and must be re-selected on RealSense top-surface validation bricks before deployment.
replaces: Approach 5 (approach_results/05_approach_checkpoint, kept unchanged as the previous baseline)
known_limitations: Brick_6_bad is never detected (colour matches the good-brick target red).
Lead over Approach 5 is 1-3 points and not statistically significant on ten bricks (McNemar p = 0.21).
Large train-test gap: the model memorises training bricks; validate on new physical bricks.
Trained on photographs on white paper, not RealSense top-surface crops.
GrabCut masks are randomly initialised; recomputed scores can differ by up to about 0.2 from cached-feature scores.
